purpose: Make the frontend an explicit operational interpretation of the production framework.
rules: Every displayed production stage maps to a defined production gate.
Current status is displayed separately from empirical evidence.
Frontend labels never promote simulated, forecast or administrative data to measured physical evidence.
S8.1 onboarding is shown as a controlled procedure with fail-closed admission controls.
Physical status remains NOT_RELEASED until the production manifest records empirical authorization and release evidence.
